evals.prompt: Set up a new project folder at <OUTPUT>\asset-tracker for a tool called Asset Tracker. It's a Python 3.12 / FastAPI / PostgreSQL 16 internal tool for the facilities team to track laptop assignments across our offices. We follow a strict engineering repo layout - requirements with IDs, architecture decision records, a traceability matrix, that whole discipline. Owner is Long VH, we're in discovery, today is 2026-09-02, issue tracker is https://jira.example.com/projects/AT, and secrets live in 1Password Secrets Automation.
evals.expected_output: A project root carrying the full contract: CLAUDE.md with the directory map, look-alike table and ID scheme; both .claude/rules files; rtm.md; an index.md per ID register. No empty folders.
assertions: CLAUDE.md exists at the project root
CLAUDE.md's directory map names all 18 top-level folders of the contract
CLAUDE.md carries the look-alike table that disambiguates confusable folders
CLAUDE.md carries the ID prefix table covering all 10 registers
No unfilled {{placeholder}} survives anywhere in the project
Both .claude/rules/documents.md and .claude/rules/code.md exist
requirements/traceability/rtm.md exists with all 7 contract columns
An index.md register exists for each of the 10 ID prefixes
The project's own stack, tracker and secret manager are filled in, not generic
No empty directory was created (structure stays lean)

evals.prompt: Four artifacts to file into an existing contract repo: an OpenAPI 3.1 spec for the telemetry ingest API, a record of the decision to use Kafka over RabbitMQ, a risk about vendor v1 API deprecation in March 2027, and notes from the 2026-09-02 design review. Registers to be updated so nothing dangles.
evals.expected_output: OpenAPI in design/interfaces/; the Kafka decision as ADR-0002 in architecture/adr/; RISK-0001 in management/risks/; notes at management/reports/2026-09-02-*. Register rows added. Repo still audits clean.
assertions: The OpenAPI spec is in design/interfaces/, not requirements/ or architecture/
The Kafka decision is an ADR under architecture/adr/, not a DEC
The new ADR takes the next free ID, ADR-0002, and is named ADR-0002-<kebab>.md
The risk is at management/risks/RISK-0001-<kebab>.md
The design review notes are in management/reports/ with a 2026-09-02- prefix
architecture/adr/index.md gained a row for the new ADR
management/risks/index.md gained a row for the new risk
Every new markdown document carries the required frontmatter fields
No new top-level directory was created
The whole repo passes check_path.py --audit with zero errors

evals.prompt: Four data artifacts to place into an existing contract repo: the logical data model, the physical schema with indexes and ERD, the JSON Schema for the telemetry payload, and the first migration. Where does each go and why.
evals.expected_output: Logical model in architecture/data/; physical schema and ERD in design/database/; JSON Schema in data/schemas/; migration under src/ beside the owning service. Repo still audits clean.
assertions: The logical data model is in architecture/data/
The physical schema and ERD are in design/database/
The JSON Schema is in data/schemas/
The migration is under src/ beside the owning service, not in design/ or data/
All four artifacts are in four different homes (none collapsed together)
No new top-level directory was created
The whole repo passes check_path.py --audit with zero errors
